criteria.name: Requested JSON form
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, gates, chain_score, final_label, and computed_consequence.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when the response includes the core fields but omits one nested group or uses minor naming differences that do not obscure the score.

criteria.name: Precipitation ledger
criteria.description: Computes gpm_max_to_mean, grid_mean_spread_fraction, and power_total_mm within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct precipitation value; lose credit for wrong aggregation windows, missing units, or ratios outside tolerance.

criteria.name: Route and dam marker count
criteria.description: Counts all five specified route/dam report markers.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for finding at least three route/dam markers; lose credit if the count is based on unrelated narrative details.

criteria.name: Exposure and access ledger
criteria.description: Computes population, building, bridge, and damaged-road metrics within tolerance.
criteria.partial_credit: Award about 1 point for each correct exposure or access metric; lose credit for confusing damaged highways with all highways or reporting raw population in thousands incorrectly.

criteria.name: Surface contrast term
criteria.description: Computes the radar-range times annual-change index and applies the negative radar-mean condition.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the correct radar range or multiplication but not both; lose credit if the negative mean condition is ignored.

criteria.name: Gate score and label
criteria.description: Applies the six gates, returns chain_score of 6, and sets the final label correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the gate count or final label is correct but the other is missing or inconsistent.

criteria.name: Bounded consequence
criteria.description: Keeps the consequence tied to the score without turning exposure counts into casualty counts or exact block-level damage.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points for a mostly bounded consequence with a small overstatement; award 0 for casualty, loss, or impact statements not derived from the ledger.

decision_rule.summary: Six fixed gates score the rainfall, wadi/dam route, exposure, access, and surface terms.

thresholds.final_label: rainfall_wadi_dam_exposure_chain if chain_score >= 5 and route_dam_gate else insufficient_chain_score
